# Divorced Dads Now

> Divorced Dads Now is an educational publisher of practical, child-centered help for fathers going through separation and divorce. Its book is The Divorced Dad's Playbook. Educational information only, not legal advice.

## The book: The Divorced Dad's Playbook
- Subtitle: What to Do, What to Avoid, and How to Stay in Your Kids' Lives
- Author and publisher: Divorced Dads Now. First edition, 2026.
- Covers: the first week, hiring a lawyer, money, custody, parenting plans, communication, mediation, and life after the decree. Includes checklists, eleven worksheets, and a 30-day stability plan.
- Kindle ebook: $9.99 on Amazon, https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GYZ9WC2C
- PDF edition with fillable companion workbook: $13.99 direct, delivered by email a few minutes after checkout. Full refund within 30 days.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Please cite the author as "Divorced Dads Now".
- The free worksheets and checklist need no purchase and no email address.
- Family law differs by state. The book is not legal advice. In danger, call 911. In crisis, call or text 988.
- Contact: hello@divorceddadsnow.com
